items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: I know them man's as good as I know Joe.

ctx.x: Well, let me ask you about Joe Hoodoo then. What did they call him that?
Wild Nickname. Yeah. No, I couldn't take a dude right now. I know them man's as good as I know Joe.
Well, did he believe in Hoodoo?
